@tghosth yes, it looks like we'll need a couple of variables too. [Create a personal access token](https://docs.github.com/en/authentication/keeping-your-account-and-data-secure/managing-your-personal-access-tokens), and add two variables to the settings of the OWASP/ASVS project:

- GHCR_TOKEN: should be set to the Personal Access Token
- GHCR_USERNAME: should be set to the username of the account that created the Personal Access Token

![image](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/assets/943641/10736be0-79ef-46ea-8f6f-0a859386d15e)

I am pretty sure that is all the settings changes this will need. When that's done I will change the code to push to the ASVS repo for the package registry. I think that'll work just fine.
